description: Last Logged MVP - iOS app for tracking recurring life events with one-tap logging, elapsed time display, smart reminders, interactive home screen widgets, and freemium subscription

userStories.title: Xcode project scaffolding with MVVM folder structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a clean Xcode project with MVVM folder structure and SPM dependencies so that all future stories have a consistent foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Xcode project created with iOS 17+ deployment target and SwiftUI lifecycle
MVVM folder structure exists: Models/, ViewModels/, Views/ (with Home/, Detail/, Onboarding/, Settings/, Components/ subfolders), Services/, Widget/, Utilities/
Swift Package dependencies declared: supabase-swift, RevenueCat, TelemetryDeck SDK
App Group capability configured for widget data sharing (group.com.pearsonmedia.lastlogged)
Main app entry point renders a placeholder ContentView
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: SwiftData models for TrackerItem, CompletionLog, and TrackerCategory
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core SwiftData @Model classes so that tracker data can be persisted locally and queried efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: TrackerItem @Model with fields: id (UUID), name (String), categoryId (UUID), reminderIntervalDays (Int?), lastCompletedAt (Date?), createdAt (Date), sortOrder (Int), iconName (String), isArchived (Bool), syncStatus (SyncStatus enum)
CompletionLog @Model with fields: id (UUID), trackerItemId (UUID), completedAt (Date), notes (String?)
TrackerCategory @Model with fields: id (UUID), name (String), iconName (String), colorHex (String), sortOrder (Int), isDefault (Bool)
SyncStatus enum defined with cases: synced, pending, conflict
SwiftData ModelContainer configured in the app entry point with all three models
Shared ModelContainer uses App Group container for widget access
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Default category seed data
userStories.description: As a user, I want pre-populated categories available on first launch so I can quickly start tracking common life events.
acceptanceCriteria: Six default TrackerCategory records seeded on first launch: Home Maintenance, Health & Wellness, Car Care, Personal Care, Social & Family, Pet Care
Each category has an appropriate SF Symbol iconName and distinct colorHex
Each category has isDefault set to true
Seed data only inserts if no categories exist (idempotent first-launch check)
A DataSeeder utility class handles seeding logic
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: HomeViewModel with CRUD operations and sorting
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an @Observable HomeViewModel that manages tracker items with create, read, update, archive, and sort operations so the UI can bind to reactive state.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeViewModel is an @Observable class
Fetches all non-archived TrackerItems grouped by TrackerCategory using @Query or manual fetch
Supports creating a new TrackerItem with name, category, reminder interval, and icon
Supports archiving (soft delete) a TrackerItem by setting isArchived = true
Supports updating sortOrder for manual reordering within a category
Exposes computed property for items sorted by most overdue first (based on lastCompletedAt and reminderIntervalDays)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Home screen list view with category grouping
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all my tracked items on the home screen grouped by category so I can quickly find and manage them.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeView displays TrackerItems in a scrollable List grouped by TrackerCategory
Each category section has a header showing category name and icon
Each tracker row shows: item name, SF Symbol icon, and a placeholder for elapsed time
Empty state view shown when no trackers exist with a call-to-action to create the first tracker
Navigation title set to 'Last Logged'
Add button (+) in the toolbar navigates to tracker creation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: One-tap event logging with haptic feedback and undo toast
userStories.description: As a user, I want to log an event with a single tap and see confirmation so that tracking is frictionless.
acceptanceCriteria: Each tracker row displays a prominent checkmark.circle.fill button
Tapping the button creates a new CompletionLog with current timestamp
Tapping updates TrackerItem.lastCompletedAt to the current timestamp
UIImpactFeedbackGenerator fires medium haptic on tap
A transient toast/snackbar appears showing 'Logged! Undo' for 4 seconds
Tapping 'Undo' on the toast deletes the CompletionLog and reverts lastCompletedAt
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Elapsed time display with color-coded urgency
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see how long ago I last completed each item with color-coded urgency so I know what needs attention.
acceptanceCriteria: Each tracker row shows human-readable elapsed time using RelativeDateTimeFormatter (e.g., '3 days ago', '2 weeks ago')
Items with no completion history show 'Never logged'
Color coding based on reminder interval: green (within schedule, <75% of interval), yellow (approaching due, 75-100%), red (overdue, >100%)
Items with no reminder interval show neutral/default color
Elapsed time updates when the view appears or a log is recorded
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Custom tracker creation form
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create custom trackers with a name, category, reminder interval, and icon so I can track anything important to me.
acceptanceCriteria: AddTrackerView presents a form with: name (required text field), category (Picker from existing categories), reminder interval (optional toggle with days/weeks/months picker and numeric input), icon (SF Symbol picker with search)
Form validates that name is not empty before allowing save
Save button creates a new TrackerItem via HomeViewModel and dismisses the form
Cancel button dismisses without saving
SF Symbol picker shows a searchable grid of common SF Symbols
Default icon is 'checkmark.circle' if none selected
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Edit and archive tracker functionality
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit tracker details or archive trackers I no longer need so I can keep my list clean and accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Swipe-to-archive gesture on tracker rows with destructive style confirmation
Context menu on long-press with options: Edit, Archive
EditTrackerView reuses the AddTrackerView form pre-populated with existing values
Saving edits updates the TrackerItem in SwiftData
Archiving sets isArchived = true and removes the item from the home list
TrackerDetailViewModel created as @Observable class managing single item state
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Pre-built category templates with starter items
userStories.description: As a user, I want pre-built tracker templates in each category so I can quickly add common items without manual entry.
acceptanceCriteria: CategoryTemplates utility defines starter items per category with name, iconName, and recommended reminderIntervalDays
Home Maintenance: HVAC filter (90d), smoke detector batteries (180d), gutter cleaning (180d), water heater flush (365d), dryer vent cleaning (365d)
Health & Wellness: Dental cleaning (180d), annual physical (365d), eye exam (365d), flu shot (365d)
Car Care: Oil change (90d), tire rotation (180d), air filter (365d), brake inspection (365d)
Personal Care: Haircut (42d), deep clean house (30d), wash bedding (14d)
Social & Family: Call parents (14d), call close friend (30d), date night (14d)
Pet Care: Flea/tick treatment (30d), heartworm medication (30d), vet checkup (365d), grooming (60d)
Template items can be bulk-added to the user's trackers from a template picker view
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: NotificationService with smart reminder scheduling
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive local notifications when tracked items are due so I don't forget recurring tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: NotificationService class handles all UNUserNotificationCenter interactions
Requests notification permission on first tracker with a reminder interval
Schedules UNCalendarNotificationTrigger for each tracker at 9:00 AM on the due date
Notification content: 'It's been [X days] since your last [item name]. Time to log it!'
Notification includes a 'Log Now' action button via UNNotificationAction
Handles the 64 pending notification limit by prioritizing: overdue items first, then soonest-due
Reschedules all notifications when any tracker is logged or modified
NotificationService is a singleton accessible from ViewModels
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: App Group container and shared SwiftData store for widgets
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the App Group container configured so the widget extension can read tracker data from the shared SwiftData store.
acceptanceCriteria: App Group (group.com.pearsonmedia.lastlogged) is configured in both main app and widget extension targets
ModelContainer is initialized with the App Group container URL for shared storage
A WidgetDataProvider utility reads TrackerItems and CompletionLogs from the shared store
WidgetDataProvider exposes a method to get the top N most overdue items sorted by urgency
Widget extension target created in the Xcode project
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Small and medium home screen widgets
userStories.description: As a user, I want small and medium home screen widgets showing my most overdue items so I can check status without opening the app.
acceptanceCriteria: WidgetKit TimelineProvider implemented with getTimeline returning entries refreshed every 30 minutes
Small widget (2x2) shows: single most overdue item name, elapsed time, urgency color indicator
Medium widget (4x2) shows: top 3 most overdue items each with name, elapsed time, and urgency color
Widget background uses the app's theme colors
Empty state shown when no trackers exist: 'Open Last Logged to start tracking'
Widget configuration uses StaticConfiguration (no user-configurable intent needed for MVP)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Large widget and interactive AppIntent actions
userStories.description: As a user, I want a large widget with category grouping and interactive log buttons on all widgets so I can log completions without opening the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Large widget (4x4) shows top 5 overdue items with category labels and color-coded urgency
LogCompletionIntent AppIntent defined that accepts a tracker item ID parameter
Interactive checkmark button on medium and large widget items triggers LogCompletionIntent
LogCompletionIntent creates a CompletionLog, updates lastCompletedAt, and reloads the widget timeline
Small widget taps open the app to the relevant tracker (deep link via widgetURL)
All widget sizes use consistent visual styling
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: RevenueCat service integration and subscription configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need RevenueCat SDK integrated and configured with the subscription tiers so the app can manage purchases and entitlements.
acceptanceCriteria: RevenueCatService singleton class wraps Purchases SDK initialization
Configured with API key placeholder (to be set in production)
Three product identifiers defined: premium_monthly ($3.99), premium_annual ($24.99), lifetime ($59.99)
RevenueCatService exposes: current subscription tier (free/premium/lifetime), isPremium computed property, purchase method, restore purchases method
Subscription status updates observed via Purchases delegate
RevenueCatService initialized at app launch in the App struct
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Paywall screen with pricing tiers and free tier enforcement
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a clear paywall with pricing options, and as a free user I should be limited to 5 trackers so there is a natural upgrade path.
acceptanceCriteria: PaywallView displays three subscription options: Monthly ($3.99/mo with 7-day trial), Annual ($24.99/yr with 48% savings badge and 7-day trial), Lifetime ($59.99 one-time)
Annual plan is pre-selected as the default option
Purchase buttons trigger RevenueCatService.purchase()
Restore purchases link at the bottom calls RevenueCatService.restorePurchases()
Free tier enforces: max 5 TrackerItems, completion history limited to last 10 entries per item, 1 widget style
Hard paywall presented when user tries to create a 6th tracker on free tier
Soft paywall presented during onboarding flow
Legal links to privacy policy and terms of service at the bottom
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Supabase PostgreSQL schema and RLS policies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Supabase database schema with tables, indexes, and Row Level Security policies so user data is securely stored server-side.
acceptanceCriteria: SQL migration file creates users table with: id, auth_id, display_name, subscription_tier, created_at, updated_at
SQL migration creates tracker_items table mirroring SwiftData model with user_id foreign key
SQL migration creates completion_logs table with tracker_item_id and user_id foreign keys
SQL migration creates tracker_categories table with user_id foreign key
RLS enabled on all tables with policies enforcing user_id = auth.uid()
Indexes created: tracker_items(user_id, is_archived), tracker_items(user_id, last_completed_at), completion_logs(tracker_item_id, completed_at DESC), completion_logs(user_id, completed_at DESC)
Migration file is self-contained and can be run against a Supabase PostgreSQL instance
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: SupabaseService with offline-first data sync
userStories.description: As a user, I want my data synced to the cloud when I sign in so I can access it across devices without waiting for the network.
acceptanceCriteria: SupabaseService class wraps supabase-swift client initialization with URL and anon key placeholders
Push method uploads all TrackerItems, CompletionLogs, and TrackerCategories with syncStatus == .pending to Supabase
Pull method fetches remote changes since last sync timestamp and merges into SwiftData
Conflict resolution uses last-write-wins based on updated_at timestamp
Sync triggers on: app foreground, network recovery, and after local writes (debounced)
All local CRUD operations work without network (offline-first)
SyncStatus on TrackerItems updates to .synced after successful push
SupabaseService is a singleton accessible from ViewModels
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Supabase Auth with Apple Sign In and Email/Password
userStories.description: As a user, I want to optionally sign in with Apple or email so my data is backed up and synced, but I can also use the app without an account.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth screen with 'Sign in with Apple' button using AuthenticationServices framework
Email/password sign-up and sign-in form as an alternative
Supabase Auth session persisted and restored on app launch
After successful sign in, SupabaseService automatically starts syncing
Sign out option in settings that clears the session but preserves local SwiftData
App is fully functional without signing in (auth is optional)
User profile created/updated in the users table on sign in
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Hono edge functions sidecar with reminder digest
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the edge functions Docker sidecar with the daily reminder digest so users with 64+ notifications still get alerted about overdue items.
acceptanceCriteria: Node.js 20 project initialized with Hono framework and TypeScript
Dockerfile for Coolify deployment on the same Docker network as Supabase
supabase-js server client configured with service role key placeholder
send-reminder-digest endpoint: queries all users with overdue items beyond the 64-notification local limit, compiles a summary, sends push via APNs
node-cron job scheduled for daily 8:00 AM execution
APNs integration via @parse/node-apn with certificate placeholder config
Health check endpoint at GET /health returns 200
Environment variables documented in .env.example
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Edge functions for subscription webhook and data export
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RevenueCat subscription webhook and data export endpoints so subscription status stays in sync and users can export their data.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /webhooks/revenuecat endpoint validates RevenueCat webhook signature
Webhook handler updates users.subscription_tier based on event type (INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, CANCELLATION, EXPIRATION)
POST /export-data endpoint accepts authenticated user request
Export generates JSON with all user's tracker_items, completion_logs, and tracker_categories
Export also supports CSV format via query parameter ?format=csv
Endpoints return appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages
Routes added to the main Hono app alongside the reminder digest
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Onboarding walkthrough with category selection
userStories.description: As a new user, I want a brief onboarding walkthrough that helps me select categories and understand the app so I can start tracking immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: OnboardingView presents 3 screens in a TabView with page indicators
Screen 1: Welcome - app name, tagline ('When did I last...?'), key value proposition
Screen 2: Category selection - checkboxes for each default category, pre-selects all, user can deselect unwanted categories
Screen 3: Widget prompt - visual instructions to add the home screen widget with a 'Get Started' button
Selected categories seed their template tracker items on completion
OnboardingViewModel tracks completion state and persists via @AppStorage so onboarding only shows once
Soft paywall presented after screen 3 before entering the main app
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Settings screen with account and notification preferences
userStories.description: As a user, I want a settings screen where I can manage my account, notification preferences, and data so I feel in control of the app.
acceptanceCriteria: SettingsView organized in sections: Account, Notifications, Data, About
Account section: sign in/out button, subscription status, manage subscription link
Notifications section: global toggle for reminders, default reminder time picker
Data section: export data button (triggers edge function or local export), clear all data with confirmation alert
About section: app version, privacy policy link, terms of service link, support email link (support@lastlogged.com)
SettingsViewModel as @Observable class managing settings state
Settings accessible from the home screen toolbar via gear icon
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Completion history view per tracker item
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the history of all completions for a tracker item so I can review my patterns over time.
acceptanceCriteria: TrackerDetailView shows item name, category, reminder interval, and current elapsed time at the top
Scrollable list of CompletionLog entries sorted by completedAt descending
Each history entry shows: date formatted as 'MMM d, yyyy at h:mm a', and relative time ago
Free tier shows only the last 10 entries with a 'See full history - Upgrade' prompt
Premium users see full unlimited history
Navigation from home screen tracker row tap to TrackerDetailView
Edit button in toolbar navigates to EditTrackerView
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Dark mode support, app icon, and accessibility
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to support dark mode, have a polished app icon, and be accessible so it works well in all contexts.
acceptanceCriteria: All views support both light and dark mode using adaptive system colors and Color assets
Custom Color assets defined for brand colors that adapt to light/dark appearance
App icon asset catalog configured with placeholder icon (1024x1024)
All interactive elements have accessibilityLabel and accessibilityHint set
VoiceOver navigates the home list, log buttons, and widgets correctly
Dynamic Type supported on all text elements
Minimum tap target size of 44x44 points on all buttons
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: TelemetryDeck analytics integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need privacy-first analytics tracking key user events so we can measure engagement and conversion without compromising user privacy.
acceptanceCriteria: TelemetryDeck SDK initialized at app launch with app ID placeholder
Events tracked: item_created, item_logged, widget_tapped, onboarding_completed, paywall_presented, trial_started, category_selected
No personally identifiable information sent in any event
Analytics service is a lightweight wrapper class in Services/AnalyticsService.swift
Analytics calls are fire-and-forget (never block UI)
Typecheck passes

userStories.description: As a potential user, I want to visit lastlogged.com and see a compelling landing page with features, pricing, and App Store download link so I can learn about and download the app.

Footer with links to Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and support email
Responsive design that works on mobile and desktop
Cloudflare Pages deployment configuration (wrangler.toml or pages config)
SEO meta tags, Open Graph tags, and JSON-LD structured data

Terms of Service page at /terms with sections: acceptance of terms, subscription terms, user responsibilities, limitation of liability, contact info
